name: Exponent-based Quantization with Priority Promotion
definition: A lossy compression technique for neural network weights that partitions floating-point numbers into buckets based on their exponent and sign, then reduces the number of buckets using priority promotion to limit indexing bits.
summary: Exponent-based Quantization with Priority Promotion is a lossy compression technique that groups neural network weights by exponent to enable finer granularity in high-magnitude regions while reducing bucket count via priority promotion.
